recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the published FHIR-32461 request for HealthcareService without broadening source.observer to later actor additions such as DeviceDefinition or Group, which should remain governed by their own issue history if further expansion is desired.
issue_request: FHIR-32461 was Published as Persuasive for R5. It asked whether AuditEvent.source.observer could be HealthCareService or CareTeam because these pseudo-organization actors should generally appear where Organization appears; the approved resolution was to update .source.observer to include all agents defined in the event pattern .participant.
initial_application: Git commit f8115b34e06b57257a99858a91039ffb6fcd1a61 initially applied FHIR-32461 by changing AuditEvent.source.observer target profiles and adding CareTeam, but it did not add HealthcareService.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. Related FHIR-32454 updated AuditEvent.agent.who to follow Event performer actor types. Later FHIR-49304 recognized HealthcareService as an Event performer/actor, and applied FHIR-49672 plus commit 390878350715eca86888de3f0cfe40e5cec1200c added HealthcareService to AuditEvent.agent.who. A prior reconciliation for FHIR-32465 already aligned AuditEvent.source observer wording with actors rather than source systems.
reconciliation: Updated source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml so AuditEvent.source.observer includes http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/HealthcareService. No generated diagram or SVG artifacts were edited.
source_changes: source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml: added HealthcareService to AuditEvent.source.observer Reference target profiles.
